'''''CRC Concise Encyclopedia of Mathematics''''' is a book by American author [[Eric W. Weisstein]].

==Summary==

The book is presented in a dictionary format. The book is divided into [[headword]]s. The book also provides relevant diagrams and illustrations.

==Lawsuits==

The book became the subject of a lawsuit between [[CRC Press]] and [[Eric W. Weisstein]].<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.ericweisstein.com/authors-rights/authors_note.html |title=ericweisstein.com |access-date=2012-06-29 |archive-date=2013-04-08 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20130408051607/http://www.ericweisstein.com/authors-rights/authors_note.html |url-status=dead }}</ref> The CRC Press claimed Weisstein's website ''[[MathWorld]]'' violated the copyright on the CRC Concise Encyclopedia of Mathematics. During the dispute, a court order shut down ''MathWorld'' for over a year starting October 23, 2000. According to Eric Weisstein's personal site, he restarted MathWorld on November 6, 2001.<ref>{{cite web |title= Updates about the CRC Lawsuit |publisher= Eric Weisstein |date= April 5, 2009 |url= http://www.ericweisstein.com/authors-rights/updates.html |access-date= June 16, 2020 |archive-url= https://web.archive.org/web/20130408052034/http://www.ericweisstein.com/authors-rights/updates.html |archive-date= April 8, 2013 |url-status= dead }}</ref> Wolfram Research, [[Stephen Wolfram]], and Eric Weisstein settled with the CRC Press for an undisclosed financial award and several benefits. Among these benefits are the legal rights to reproduce ''MathWorld'' in book format again.{{Citation needed|date=June 2020}}

==Reception==

The book has consistently received good reviews.<ref>[http://www.goodreads.com/book/show/2600113-crc-concise-encyclopedia-of-mathematics goodreads.com]</ref><ref>{{cite journal | url=https://www.jstor.org/stable/20453513 | jstor=20453513 | title=Featured Review: CRC Concise Encyclopedia of Mathematics | last1=Previato | first1=Emma | journal=SIAM Review | date=2004 | volume=46 | issue=2 | pages=349–354 }}</ref><ref>[http://www.emeraldinsight.com/journals.htm?articleid=1497141 emeraldinsight.com]</ref>
